checked_scope: The sharp always-observed-stratum bounds, nesting over feasible mass, and the grid approximation used for inference.
checks: Four observation-stratum masses imply q∈[max(0,p₀+p₁−1,p₀−δ),min(p₀,p₁)]; conditional effects require q>0.
Fractional atomic trimming attains both arm endpoint submeasures jointly by arbitrary cross-world coupling; bottom means increase and top means decrease with q, so the intervals nest.
The binary examples produce [1/6,1/2] at q=.6 and [−.25,.75] at q=.4. Pointwise rounding error remains ≤2/K after conditioning, without a 1/q penalty; one category event covers all δ.
limitations: Approval applies only to the review’s expressly stated mathematical scope under the manuscript assumptions. It is not human peer review, formal verification, certification of historical novelty, experimental validation, or editorial acceptance. Bibliographic third-party claims and excluded extensions were not independently certified.
